name: OpenClaw bounded automation queue

nodes.name: Signed Webhook
nodes.purpose: Receive a Make or local signed request

nodes.name: Verify Signature
nodes.purpose: Canonicalize JSON and verify HMAC; never print the secret

nodes.name: Validate Packet
nodes.purpose: Require version, proposal_id, execution_key, allowlisted action and bounded payload

nodes.name: Idempotency Check
nodes.purpose: Reject an existing execution_key in the queue ledger

nodes.name: Queue Only
nodes.purpose: Insert pending low-risk work; do not execute it from the webhook request

activation_gates: credentials are created inside n8n, never embedded in workflow JSON
workflow remains inactive until one valid and three negative test cases pass
existing Telegram workflow remains the only polling owner
error workflow redacts Authorization, Cookie, API key and HMAC fields
